description: Canonical AFKSwitch support matrix. scripts/validate.py renders it into docs/details.md, spec/presence.md and adapters/README.md (python scripts/validate.py --write) and fails when they drift. liveVerified is true only with a dated live check in docs/compatibility.md. The root README keeps a shorter hand-written summary.

capabilities.state: Read and write durable presence state.
capabilities.sync: Reconcile global generation with session last_seen_generation at a lifecycle boundary before meaningful work; reset starts a new epoch.
capabilities.notify: Proactively deliver presence events to running peers through native host mechanisms.
capabilities.fanIn: Collect peer status on /back with honest delivery and no invented replies.
capabilities.visualSwitch: Explicit visual input to the existing skills, on the declared visualSwitchSurfaces only; requires function hooks.

hosts.name: Claude Code
hosts.notes: Read-only SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse sync; native notification and return status collection; a read-only PermissionRequest hook declines approval prompts while away (AFKSWITCH_KEEP_PROMPTS=1 keeps them). Visual switch on the terminal and the desktop app, on builds with function hooks; terminal clicks live-tested on Windows with Claude Code 2.1.287. The desktop drawing, macOS and Linux are covered by the module tests, not by a live click. The Claude plugin directory copy currently omits the switch while mods are reviewed.
hosts.evidence: hooks/hooks.json; hooks/switch.tsx and switch.test.ts; scripts/presence_hook.py; bundled skills: ListAgents, SendMessage, notify_when_idle.

hosts.name: Codex
hosts.notes: Hooks for SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and PostToolUse (transcript marker, like Claude Code); the installer writes them to ~/.codex/hooks.json and Codex asks you to trust them with /hooks. The default sandbox blocks $afk from writing ~/.afkswitch: use the afkswitch command or --codex-writable-state. Notify NOT SUPPORTED: codex queue --thread <id> --message may start a turn (wake/credits); codex agents has no machine-readable listing or delivery receipt. FanIn NOT SUPPORTED: no reply channel.
hosts.evidence: hooks/codex.json; scripts/presence_hook.py; scripts/install.py; synthetic conformance/hooks and conformance/install tests only.

hosts.name: Hermes Agent
hosts.notes: pre_llm_call shell hook in ~/.hermes/config.yaml, told on every call while away (short event only); Hermes asks once to approve it. Skills are not installed by default because Hermes has no manual-only flag and the model could change presence; --hermes-skills opts in. Notify and fanIn are not supported.
hosts.evidence: adapters/hermes/hooks.yaml; scripts/presence_hook.py; scripts/install.py; synthetic conformance/hooks and conformance/install tests only.

hosts.name: Cursor
hosts.notes: Skills from ~/.agents/skills; a sessionStart hook tells new sessions while away. Later events stay unwired until a live test shows Cursor keeps the marker in its transcript. Notify and fanIn are not supported.
hosts.evidence: adapters/cursor/hooks.json; scripts/presence_hook.py; scripts/install.py; synthetic conformance/hooks and conformance/install tests only.

hosts.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
hosts.notes: Skills from ~/.agents/skills; a sessionStart hook in ~/.copilot/hooks tells new sessions while away (userPromptSubmitted output is dropped by the host). Notify and fanIn are not supported.
hosts.evidence: adapters/copilot/afkswitch.json; scripts/presence_hook.py; scripts/install.py; synthetic conformance/hooks and conformance/install tests only.

hosts.name: Antigravity CLI
hosts.notes: PreInvocation hook, told on every call while away (short event only). The installer copies the plugin to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/afkswitch and the skills to ~/.gemini/config/skills. Skills may be auto-invoked: Antigravity documents no manual-only flag. Notify and fanIn are not supported.
hosts.evidence: adapters/agy/; scripts/install.py; synthetic conformance/hooks and conformance/install tests only.

hosts.name: Generic local agent
hosts.notes: Sync via the reference helper when the host calls check before each turn.
